messages:
anita: Heads-up — planning prod deploy today 2026-03-18 19:00 UTC (release/2026.3). Main changes: runtime batching tweaks + kernel selection fallback. Short preflight below, please ack your ownership and update status. If you see a blocker ping here.

anita: Preflight checklist (canary -> gradual):
- [ ] Canary deploy to us-west1 (5% traffic)
- [ ] Canary smoke tests (latency, errors, token-rate)
- [ ] Observability: traces + token-level cost dashboards ready
- [ ] Rollback hook tested & documented
- [ ] Capacity: autoscale policy validated for peak bursts
- [ ] Secrets/KMS access validated for private models
- [ ] Post-deploy canary evaluation runbook ready

anita: Quick notes: canary window 19:05-19:25 UTC, full rollout 19:30 if green. Timeout for go/no-go 19:28.

alex: ack — I'll own canary smoke and latency checks. Will run smoke at T+5m and report numbers.

casey: ack — I'll watch logs + traces, rollback hook is in S3: s3://runbooks/rollback/2026-03-18.md. I ran the drill in staging yesterday.

michael: ack — no DB migrations in this change. I'll watch config rollout (feature flag: enable-new-kernels).

jon: ack — infra autoscale validated; burst reserve is set to +20% for the window. I'll keep an eye on node provisioning.

sara: ack — secrets/KMS check complete (tested KMS decrypt via staging job). Will verify prod key access 10m before canary.

deploy-bot: Reminder: scheduled deploy (release/2026.3) will start in 60 minutes. Staging smoke checks passed earlier.

anita: Smoke test command (use from bastion with appropriate token):
```bash
# basic smoke
curl -sSf -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" https://api.redwood.prod/v1/generate -d '{"model":"rw-infer-v2","input":"hello"}' | jq .
```

alex: ran staging smoke @18:40 UTC — p95 latency 115ms, error rate 0.1%. Re-ran input fuzz and no crashes. Ready for canary.

casey: grep'd logs for OOMs in canary image: none. Trace sampling hooked. Set alerts for tail-latency > 1s.

michael: feature flag rollout plan:
- stage: enable new-kernels=true for 10% routes
- canary: toggle for canary instances only
- full: flip on 19:30 if green
I will run the toggle and post timeline.

sara: verified prod KMS access at 18:52 UTC. Secrets rotation not required for this deploy.

anita: small rollback playbook excerpt (for quick reference):
- abort rollout in console
- revert feature flag to `enable-new-kernels=false`
- if model-level issues: switch routing policy to fallback variant `rw-infer-stable`
- scale canary down to 0%

casey: practiced the revert flow in staging. revert command for console CLI: `redwoodctl rollout revert --release release/2026.3 --to previous`  (tested)

alex: planning to run canary smoke at 19:07 UTC (canary spins at 19:05). Will post p50/p95 + errors within 5m.

jon: infra note: if we see provisioning slowdowns, I'll manually add 2 GPU nodes to the pool. Will stand by.

anita: tiny ask — please add :thumbsup: once your item is green so I can mark complete.

alex: :thumbsup: canary smoke green at 19:12 UTC. p50 98ms, p95 210ms, errors 0.08%.

casey: :thumbsup: logs and traces look clean. No regression alerts triggered.

michael: :thumbsup: feature flag toggled for canary instances at 19:05 and verified.

sara: :thumbsup: KMS check green.

jon: :thumbsup: capacity OK, no provisioning issues.

anita: All owners acked and green. Starting gradual rollout at 19:30 UTC per plan. Will monitor first 15m and post results. If anything anomalous, we'll trigger the rollback playbook.

deploy-bot: Deploy started for release/2026.3 at 19:30:12 UTC. Canary instances: 6.

anita: post-rollout check schedule:
- 19:35 quick health check (errors, tail-latency)
- 19:45 cost & token-rate sanity check
- 19:55 final go/no-go for full traffic

alex: quick health @19:35: errors steady, tail-latency spike 1.2s for a small subset. Investigating top traces.

casey: looking — spike traces point to a model kv-cache miss pattern for long-context sessions. Setting a temporary alert threshold and adding sampling.

michael: I can temporarily route long-context sessions to `rw-infer-stable` if spike persists. On standby.

anita: decision window open — if spike > 1s for >5% of requests in next 5m, we'll rollback. Monitoring closely.

alex: within the 5m window it drops to 0.8s after cache warming. I think keep going, watching.

anita: ok — continuing. Will post final status at 19:55.

deploy-bot: Canary phase complete at 19:48:03 UTC. No automatic rollback triggered.

anita: Final: deployment successful, full rollout started at 19:55 UTC. Thanks all for quick responses — will follow up with short post-deploy notes and perf dashboard links. :party_popper:
